Principles
Core design principles and rules for building with the design system.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

design-philosophy  Design Philosophy - A design system that prioritizes consistency, adaptability, and developer
                   experience. Every decision flows from a few core ideas:
rules              Rules - Eight rules that keep app code on-system.
styling-approach   Styling Approach - The design system supports multiple styling approaches. Every component accepts an
                   `xstyle` prop for StyleX style overrides via `stylex.create()`. For layout and wrapper styling
                   outside of components, use StyleX or Tailwind utilities;...
anti-patterns      Anti-Patterns - Patterns that break theming, routing, or layout, and what to use instead.
design-tokens      Design Tokens - The design system provides semantic design tokens for spacing, color, radius, shadow,
                   typography, and size. Tokens adapt to the active theme and color mode. Run `bunx
                   @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs tokens` for the full reference with all values.

Read one section: bunx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs principles <section>
Read everything:  bunx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs principles --full
